notes.decision: Coptic numeral with ⲙ̄ = 40 and ϩ̄ standing in for the 6-numeral (stigma/ⲋ̄) yields 46. This identifies the kephalaion as 'On the Four Great Works' (Polotsky-Böhlig Kephalaion 46). The use of ϩ for ⲋ is a known orthographic variant in Manichaean Coptic numbering.

Read as ⲍⲛ̄ ⲟⲩ-ϩⲉⲡ (=ϩⲁⲡ 'judgment') ⲛ̄-(ⲟ)ⲩ-ϣⲃⲓⲟ 'in a judgment of recompense'; the doubled ⲡⲡ likely reflects elision of preposition ⲍⲛ̄/ⲍⲙ̄ + article ⲟⲩ + first letter of ϩⲉⲡ. The phrase fits the eschatological accounting (cf. line 5 'according to their works and their sins').

Read as ⲁⲩ-ⲧⲁⲍⲙ̄ (=ⲧⲱϩⲙ̄ 'summon, call'; cf. accumulated ⲧⲁⲍⲙ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'summon forth') with 3pl perfect prefix ⲁ-. The Great Builder is 'summoned' to construct the New Aeon — fitting Manichaean cosmogonic vocabulary.
Lycopolitan collective 'the four' (= Sah. ⲡϥⲧⲟⲟⲩ); cf. accumulated entry ⲡϩⲧⲁⲩ. Used four times on this page in the cosmological enumeration of the Four Great Works.

The ordinal 'second' appears twice (lines 23 and 25), once introducing the kind and once recapitulating it. This is likely either dittographic elaboration ('the second kind is the eight earths... [namely] the second kind is from this earth...') or a scribal slip. I retain both as 'second kind' since the sequence first/second/third/fourth is otherwise complete (lines 20, 23, 27, 31).
Read as Lyc. variant of ⲱⲗ/ⲱⲗⲕ̄ 'be drawn together, be gathered.' With ⲁϩⲟⲩⲛ ⲁⲣⲁⲩ 'into them' yields 'gathered into them.' Could alternatively be a relative form of ⲉⲗ (ⲱⲗ) 'roll/twist together.'

Anomalous form. Most likely a Lycopolitan compound ⲧⲁ-ⲡⲓⲱⲧ '(she-)of-the-Father' or simply a dialectal form of ⲡⲓⲱⲧ 'the Father' (with feminine relative ⲧⲁ-). Given the editor's restoration in line 34 of [ⲙⲛ ⲧⲁⲧⲙⲉⲩ ⲛ-] 'with the Mother of —,' the standard Manichaean Father/Mother of Life pair is in view. Translated 'the Father (of Life)' with this caveat.

Qualitative of ⲛⲁϣⲉ 'be many/great' with 3sg.f. subject ⲉⲥ-/ⲥ̄ — 'she is great/abundant.' The feminine pronoun refers to ⲧⲥⲫⲁⲓⲣⲁ (sphere) or to the lacunous noun ending in -ⲉ that 'she-is-great' modifies.
